# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made against the current default branch. Users should run the latest available release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/apimgr/whois/security/advisories/new), the primary reporting channel. Do not file vulnerabilities as public issues. The deployed application also publishes its security policy at `/server/security` and contact metadata at `/.well-known/security.txt`.

Include the affected version, impact, and steps to reproduce. Avoid accessing or modifying other users' data, and stop testing if sensitive information is encountered. Maintainers will acknowledge the report, coordinate a fix and disclosure with the reporter, and credit the reporter when requested.
